headline: Content design · UX writing · Content strategy · Information architecture

impact.label: better task completion across priority journeys, through clearer UX copy, stronger structure and testing with users
less journey drop-off and avoidable support contact, by simplifying guidance, calls to action and transactional content
conversion on optimised e-commerce journeys at Time and Money, alongside around 20% more engagement with key content
product and service journeys using content style guides and reusable patterns I created
workshops, user interviews and content critiques facilitated, turned into prioritised improvements

roles.title: Content Designer
roles.summary: Owned content workstreams end to end on GOV.UK services, from discovery to delivery, working with design leads, interaction designers, user researchers, service designers and product owners.
points: Planned and ran workshops, user interviews and content crits to understand user needs and test design decisions before build
Produced content style guides, content matrices, copy decks and UX copy, and co-authored design system documentation
Shaped the information architecture and content structure for each service, with content requirements that balanced business, technical and accessibility needs
Joined up service information, navigation, transactional guidance and support content into one approach across touchpoints
Designed to WCAG 2.2, the GOV.UK Design System and the GOV.UK style guide
Used research, analytics and performance data to find friction and improve content after release

roles.title: Content Designer
roles.summary: Designed content for e-commerce products and services, from product discovery and navigation to category pages, product pages, calls to action and checkout.
points: Set content structure, taxonomy and reusable content patterns, with consistent terminology, style guidance and SEO-aware copy
Shaped narrative and content strategy across touchpoints from business and customer requirements
Ran user interviews, content critiques and working sessions with UX, product, SEO and client teams
Evaluated content with analytics, user research and A/B testing, and iterated on evidence
Supported product and feature launches from planning to release
Presented content thinking to clients and senior stakeholders, and built consensus across teams

community: Contributed to community events and internal workshops to build content design practice across teams
Ran content crits and peer reviews that helped teams agree shared content standards
Created reusable guidance, templates and content patterns for colleagues in design, product and research
expertise: Style guides, matrices and copy decks

items: Used for ideation, research synthesis and prototyping, always with human review
